final_test.claim: new environment seeds; existing composition distribution, not unseen combinations

gates: User explicitly requests experiments; previous no-training instruction remains active.
Dedicated Transformer smoke/formal orchestration and artifact verification must be completed before launch.
S two-round smoke must pass with same code/schema/config before either formal seed starts.
Freeze both final champion hashes before materializing final test recipes.
initialization: independent random S per seed; no MLP/champion transfer

promotion.integrity: all paired scenarios, valid rewards, no exceptions or illegal actions required
promotion.primary_metric: mean network terminal V6 utility; not predicted value-head output
promotion.threshold: paired utility difference bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
promotion.win_rate_role: diagnostic only; no veto or tie-break

resources.oom_policy: stop; revise microbatch explicitly while preserving effective batch; no automatic hardware change

stopping_rule: 2 smoke rounds; exactly 3 formal rounds per seed; errors halt, no extra rounds
